subject: Add manual range scale on heatmap

messages.author: bf3ba32b263963d3
messages.subject: Add manual range scale on heatmap
parts:
Hello I took the exemple from the ggtree website

    p <- ggtree(beast_tree, mrsd="2013-01-01") +
      geom_treescale(x=2008, y=1, offset=2) +
      geom_tiplab(size=2)
    gheatmap(p, genotype, offset=5, width=0.5, font.size=3,
             colnames_angle=-45, hjust=0) +
      scale_fill_manual(breaks=c("HuH3N2", "pdm", "trig"),
                        values=c("steelblue", "firebrick", "darkgreen"), name="genotype")



here it is shown how to add color depending on breacks (here 3 elements). But what if I have instead of qualitative values many quantitative values ? And If I want to add a color depending on ranges ?
I know that with heatmap.2 you can just add :

    breaks=c(0,70,90,100),
              col=c("white","black","red"),

where every values between 90 and 100 will be of the color red.
How to do the same with gheatmap please?

I tried something like

p2 <- ggtree(beast_tree, mrsd="2013-01-01") +
  geom_tiplab(size=2)
gheatmap(p2, genotype,
         colnames_angle=-45, hjust=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("red", "grey", "black"),
                    breaks=c('(90,100]', '(70,90]', '(0,70]'),name='genotype')

But it does not work the heatmap is still empty and I get the message :

Scale for 'fill' is already present. Adding another scale for 'fill', which will replace the existing scale.
Thank you for your help.
